source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 玄蛇化出，段狂受制
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC16 after EP02 SC15 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from Shisilang's request to fight into the first direct clash: Shisilang attacks Duan Yukai; the black serpent whip transforms into the giant幻电玄蛇; Duan Yukai is forced off the bamboo tower and into defensive retreat; hidden in the courtyard, Tuobaye and the white dragon-deer are shocked and lose composure.
title: 玄蛇化出，段狂受制

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC15 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC15 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing. SH04 required storyboard regeneration before pass because the gate-inside/outside logic was initially wrong.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 十四郎转身朝段聿铠走去，段聿铠继续呼喝青帝名讳。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 十四郎主动出手，长鞭在空中化作巨大的黑色玄蛇。段聿铠初时轻敌，被逼从竹楼落地，只能疾走护身。十四郎立在松枝上，以指控蛇，众朝阳谷来客在湖边助威。段聿铠虽仍狂笑强撑，却逐渐陷入下风。玄蛇重击将他轰向松树，躲在禁院竹后的拓拔野失声惊呼，白龙鹿也受惊鸣叫，庭院内外都察觉到院中另有人藏身。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 接下来会进入段聿铠被逼至树梢、众人寻声回望、白衣女子与拓拔野的隐匿压力进一步上升。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant, restrained, fully clothed, and mostly hidden or controlled in reaction shots; do not shift focus away from the conflict beat.
Duan Yukai remains a bloodied but formidable Mirage City intruder in blue robes, never comic and never cleanly dressed.
Shisilang remains outside the forbidden courtyard and distinct from Tuobaye; his black serpent attack should feel supernatural but readable.
If the玄蛇 appears, it must remain non-gory and avoid grotesque detail while still reading as a giant black magical serpent.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Stage the conflict as readable escalation rather than dense melee. Keep serpent motion clear, reactions strong, and hidden-courtyard continuity intact.
